messages:
Aisha: Quick ask — can we assemble an exec 1‑pager + security & SLA quicksheet + short benchmark callout for enterprise deploy modes (Hosted / Dedicated / Private)? Need for next Tue webinar and field handoff. :rocket:
Tom: Got it. Audience: technical buyers (infra/platform) + procurement. CTA should be 'Request dedicated trial' + link to field form. Which benchmarks do we want to surface?
Jules: I can pull a concise benchmark blurb. Latest infra run: 99th-p50 latency / token and cost per 1k tokens across modes. Draft snippet:
```
Hosted: 40ms p50, 150ms p99, $0.015 per 1k tokens
Dedicated: 25ms p50, 70ms p99, $0.011 per 1k tokens (reserved)
Private (on-prem/VPC): 30ms p50, 90ms p99, variable cost (customer infra)
```
Jules: I’ll export a single-chart SVG and a 3-bullet callout for the brief. ETA EOD Fri.
Priya: For inbound routing — tag inbound leads from webinar as `web:enterprise-deploy` and route to AE queue `AE-enterprise` with priority=High. Field will want a short playbook: key objection handling, compliance checklist, and sample legal SLAs.
Liam: For launch posts + webinar promo — cadence: email to existing trials (Mon), LinkedIn posts (Tue/Thu), webinar registration page with one-pager download gated. I'll draft two subject lines and an AB test for the hero copy.
Tom: Messaging idea — lead with reliability & predictability: headline "Inference that scales where you need it" with subline emphasizing SLAs and private options. Callouts: guaranteed latency tiers, reserved capacity, private control plane.
Aisha: Love it. Priya can you draft the field playbook bullets? Tom + Jules please pair on the one‑pager layout and hero copy. Liam to own promo cadence and tracking. Deliverables & owners:
- One‑pager (Product Marketing: Tom + Jules) — first draft Mon EOD
- Security/SLA Quicksheet (Priya) — first draft Mon EOD
- Benchmark blurb + chart (Jules) — Fri EOD (but push if needed)
- Webinar landing + gated brief (Liam) — Mon morning
Aisha: Link to working folder: https://drive.redwood/marketing/enterprise-deploy (please drop drafts there). Campaign tag: `ENT-DEPLOY-2026` :lock: :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Reminder scheduled — webinar event created for 2026-03-10 10:00 UTC. Attendees auto-registered to `ENT-DEPLOY-2026` campaign.
Priya: I'll add a 1-page legal checklist and a short paragraph on encryption/KMS integration for the quicksheet.
Liam: I'll wire tags for lead scoring and set up the AB email test in Marketo.
Aisha: Thanks team — we'll sync Wed 11am to review drafts. Please add any blockers here before EOD Fri.
